title: chore(deps): update python-bidi requirement from >=0.4.2 to >=0.6.12
body:
Updates the requirements on [python-bidi](https://github.com/MeirKriheli/python-bidi) to permit the latest version.
Release notes

Sourced from python-bidi's releases.

v0.6.12 - 3.15 wheels, drop 3.9 for security dependencies

  • Added standard and free-threaded Python 3.15 wheel support.
  • Bumped PyO3 to 0.30.0.
  • Addressed security vulnerabilities in development dependencies; Python 3.9 support was dropped because the patched dependencies require Python 3.10+.
Changelog

Sourced from python-bidi's changelog.

0.6.12

  • Added standard and free-threaded Python 3.15 wheel support.
  • Bumped PyO3 to 0.30.0.
  • Addressed security vulnerabilities in development dependencies; Python 3.9 support was dropped because the patched dependencies require Python 3.10+.

0.6.11

  • Bump pyo3 to 0.29.0, drop unsupported 3.13t [Damian Dimmich]

0.6.10

  • CI: Windows wheel job builds standard cp313/cp314 wheels reliably by running maturin twice (standard Python first, then 3.13t/3.14t), working around win_amd64 picking only free-threaded 3.13/3.14 when all interpreters share PATH [Meir Kriheli]

  • Rust extension declares gil_used = false so it runs under free-threaded (no-GIL) Python [Meir Kriheli]

  • CI: Intel macOS wheels now built on macOS 15 (replacing macOS 13) [Meir Kriheli]
  • Use uv for nox virtualenvs; add uv.lock and document uv-based dev setup in README and CONTRIBUTING [Meir Kriheli]
  • Set requires-python = ">=3.9" explicitly in pyproject.toml [Meir Kriheli]

0.6.8

  • Added missing 3.14 build for Linux (Jonathan Duncan)

  • Added generate-import-lib for windows [Meir Kriheli]
  • Removed pypy3.9 and pypy3.10 from build, removed by pyo3 [Meir Kriheli]

title: chore(deps): update nltk requirement from >=3.8.1 to >=3.10.4
body:
Updates the requirements on [nltk](https://github.com/nltk/nltk) to permit the latest version.
Release notes

Sourced from nltk's releases.

v3.10.4

Version 3.10.4 2026-10-20

This release routes every file path, archive, download, URL fetch and external program through one sandbox that keeps reads and writes inside the trusted data directories, refuses path traversal, symlink escapes and decompression bombs, blocks requests to internal network addresses, and runs Java and other third-party tools only from trusted absolute locations with validated options and input. Pickled models now load through a restricted unpickler, XML and JSON parsing are hardened, and regular expressions, recursion and slow algorithms in the tokenizers, parsers, stemmers and corpus readers are bounded against denial-of-service input. Text that NLTK writes to the terminal, to CSV files, to the WordNet browser and to third-party tool input is sanitized against injection.

Security changes you may notice

Every refusal below raises with a message that starts with "Security Violation" and names the check, so a failure is easy to search for (PR #3877).

  • Data directories (nltk.pathsec, nltk.data): corpora, models and every other resource are read and written only inside the directories listed in nltk.data.path. A path that leaves a data root, a symlink that points out of one, and a NUL byte or encoded traversal in a resource name are refused. A data root, or a directory on the way to a resource, that another account can write to is skipped with a warning naming the directory and the remedy. Keep private data in a private directory and add it to nltk.data.path; /tmp is not a data root. Model save and load methods (perceptron, maxent, named-entity chunker, Weka, crf, hunpos, Stanford) accept destinations inside a data root only (PR #3797, #3753, #3850, #3761, #3755, #3759, #3760, #3763, #3806, #3807, #3808, #3809, #3813, #3814, #3815, #3848, #3851, #3852, #3853, #3863, #3871, #3888, #3945, #3961, #3969, #3981)
  • Downloader: downloaded package archives stay private to the installing account (0600). An install another account must read is extracted: a download made as root or outside the installing account's home extracts on its own, and nltk.download(..., extract=True) / python -m nltk.downloader --extract (or --no-extract) decide explicitly. This also unpacks the packages the index leaves zipped (wordnet, omw-1.4 ...); the extracted files are readable by every account and are found before the archive. find() names an archive it cannot read and says how to extract it instead of reporting it "not found". The downloader installs only into directories no other account can write to, treats an archive another account owns or can write to as stale and downloads it afresh, extracts only from an archive no other account could have changed since its checksum was verified, bounds the size of what it fetches, and refuses index entries and archive members that would write outside the package directory (PR #3929, #3804, #3850, #3778)
  • Pickles: nltk.data.load(..., format="pickle") reconstructs plain data only; a pickle that names any class or function is refused. Model loaders that need classes use an explicit allowlist of audited globals, so a gadget such as os.system can never be reconstructed from a model file. chat80 shelve values load the same way (PR #3794, #3754, #3757, #3802, #3817, #3823, #3824)
  • XML, JSON and YAML: nltk.xmlsec refuses any document that declares an entity or references an external one (billion-laughs, external-entity and DTD attacks) and bounds the tree depth, and every corpus XML view, the downloader index, Toolbox and internals parse through it. JSON resources load with a depth and size bound; YAML (the markdown corpus front matter and nltk.data.load(..., format="yaml")) loads through a bounded safe loader. Oversized or too deeply nested input raises ValueError naming the limit (PR #3754, #3805, #3828, #3933, #3972, #3974)
  • Regular expressions (nltk.redos): every regular expression NLTK compiles, including one you pass to RegexpTokenizer, RegexpStemmer, RegexpParser, re_show, TokenSearcher.findall, tgrep, nltk.help tag-set lookups and the concordance and nemo GUIs, now goes through nltk.redos on the regex engine. A pattern longer than 100,000 characters, nested more than 100 deep, with more than 1,000 capturing groups or an excessive repetition product is refused with nltk.redos.error, a subclass of re.error; a match that runs longer than nltk.redos.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT (5 seconds) raises TimeoutError instead of hanging. Patterns keep re syntax; match objects are the regex engine's (PR #3825, #3829, #3830, #3831, #3832, #3833, #3834, #3835, #3836, #3837, #3838, #3839, #3840, #3841, #3842, #3843, #3844, #3845, #3846, #3796, #3801, #3906, #3907, #3908, #3910)
  • Regular expressions made linear: the leading-run and re-anchoring patterns that a timeout cannot catch were rewritten or bounded in the word, Treebank, blankline, TextTiling, toktok and syllable tokenizers, the readline of corpus streams, the CoNLL SRL, TIMIT, senseval, pl196x, NKJP, Alpino, YCOE, IEER, ACE, VerbNet, reviews and Lin readers, relextract, the valuation parser, the CCG lexicon parser, dependency grammars and chomsky_normal_form, each verified on the real corpus (PR #3947, #3934, #3932, #3938, #3935, #3933, #3869, #3944, #3911, #3909, #3953, #3895)
  • Size, depth and time bounds: trees deeper than nltk.tree.MAX_TREE_DEPTH (500), WordNet and other relation walks deeper than nltk.util.MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH (500), tgrep deeper than 50, Toolbox deeper than 500, dependency graphs deeper than 200, are refused with ValueError naming the limit rather than exhausting the stack, and the stemmers, distance metrics, skipgrams, parsers and grammar transforms run in linear or bounded time with identical output for legitimate input. chart_parse stops after nltk.parse.chart.DEFAULT_MAX_TIME (5 seconds of wall-clock, needed only for feature grammars; max_time=None disables it). Tree.repr no longer recurses, so a deep accepted tree prints (PR #3827, #3885, #3895, #3767, #3784, #3917, #3958, #3960, #3977)
  • External tools and Java: a tool binary is resolved from an absolute path or a trusted search path only, never from the current directory; the binary, its directory and the model and data files handed to it must not be writable by another account (symlinked and multi-call executables such as a packaged Graphviz dot are supported). java() accepts a main class as the first argument only (no -jar, @​argfile or .java source file), validates its options against an allowlist, and loads jars only from a data root unless NLTK_ALLOW_UNSAFE_JARS=1 opts out with a warning. CoreNLP server options are allowlisted. Stanford, Malt, Senna, hunpos, Prover9, megam, TADM, Weka and crf wrappers validate their paths and the text they pipe to the tool against line and argument injection (PR #3772, #3771, #3975, #3743, #3782, #3788, #3768, #3798, #3887, #3858, #3950, #3951, #3812, #3816, #3868, #3894, #3941, #3850, #3925)
  • Network: the downloader, nltk.data.load of a URL and the CHILDES reader fetch through pathsec.urlopen, which refuses addresses that are not globally routable (loopback, private, link-local and multicast, including tunnelled and obfuscated forms), pins the validated address for the connection, allows file:// with a local authority only, and refuses a proxied fetch unless NLTK_ALLOW_PROXIED_URLOPEN=1 (or nltk.pathsec.ALLOW_PROXIED_FETCH = True) asserts the proxy is trusted. The CoreNLP client talks to its local server with requests and is not affected (PR #3847, #3810, #3750, #3850)
  • Terminal, CSV, DOT and HTML output: every print in the library goes through nltk.termsec.safe_print, which renders control characters, escape sequences and unbalanced bidi overrides from corpus text as visible \xNN escapes instead of letting them reach the terminal. The CSV files the twitter and sentiment helpers write neutralise formula-leading and control-sequence cells, AlignedSent DOT labels are escaped, the WordNet browser escapes corpus text, and nltk.data.load's verbose output no longer prints the full resource URL (PR #3914, #3915, #3937, #3946, #3931, #3930, #3856, #3902)
  • Corpus stores and encodings: the PanLex Lite and chat80 sqlite stores open read-only on a pinned descriptor with their schema screened and a statement step budget, chat80 shelves are read by a key manifest, Toolbox SFM markers are sanitised, and a resource encoding that is not a text codec (bz2_codec and friends) is refused (PR #3961, #3964, #3959, #3888, #3800, #3962)
  • Package contents: the wheel no longer ships nltk.test.unit (the attack harnesses, advisory probes and their fixtures), so pip install nltk is about half the size and import nltk.test.unit works from a source checkout or the sdist only. The doctests under nltk.test still ship (PR #3954)

Security test and CI infrastructure

  • Attack and regression harnesses, advisory probes, the sandbox conftest fixtures, the pre-commit guards (no unsandboxed open, every regex through redos, every pickle through picklesec, every print through safe_print), load-invariant CPU-time timing rules, CI matrix and runner fixes, pinned third-party downloads, and the AUTHORS update (PR #3744, #3749, #3762, #3764, #3770, #3776, #3791, #3795, #3803, #3818, #3820, #3821, #3822, #3849, #3855, #3860, #3861, #3862, #3864, #3865, #3866, #3876, #3884, #3899, #3904, #3905, #3912, #3917, #3924, #3926, #3927, #3939, #3940, #3943, #3948, #3949, #3963, #3968, #3971, #3976, #3982, #3983, #3984, #3985)

Other changes

  • Added RTL language syntactic tree visualization support (PR #3472)
  • Fix #3394: Ensure punkt_tab is downloaded when punkt is requested (PR #3505)
  • Show README.md as the PyPI long description (PR #3746)
  • Add stopwords.words("english-extended") (PR #3747)
  • Krippendorff's alpha: treat placeholder labels as missing data (#2865, #2732) (PR #3752)
  • Fix shared defaults in chat80 Concept (PR #3773)
  • Fix Java wrappers decoding str output from java() (universal_newlines) (PR #3777)
  • Prevent IndexError in Hungarian stemmer on empty string (PR #3785)
  • Isolate MTE tag filters per view (PR #3792)
  • Fix newline in ellipsis tokens in TweetTokenizer (PR #3819)
  • Isolate default WordNet reference relations (PR #3872)
  • Fix resolution paths that cancel distinct literals (PR #3878)
  • Fix UTF-8 text preprocessing in NKJP corpus reader (PR #3879)
  • Remove shadowed FeatStruct._walk stub and preserve its docstring (PR #3893)
  • Count all increasing pairs in RIBES kendall_tau (PR #3900)
  • Fix the TweetTokenizer ZWJ emoji pattern capturing adjacent whitespace (PR #3913)
  • Surface the CoreNLP server's reason for a non-2xx answer (PR #3942)
  • Omit unaligned (NULL target) pairs from Alignment strings, so IBM model output prints (PR #3967)
  • Fix DependencyGraph cycle detection, which returned False on every parsed graph (PR #3978)
  • Show, range and draw an alignment with an unaligned pair on every surface (PR #3987)

title: [DRAFT] upgrade: adopt ocr-core v2 visual-evidence contract (X→uncertain) — final pin pending v0.7.0
body:
## ما هذا الـ PR
مسودة **مسار ترقية الماراثون** لعقد ocr-core v2 (بوابة الأدلة البصرية) — قرار المالك في جولة المراجعة: تحديث عقد المستهلك هنا في PR مستقل، لا تغيير صامت في ocr-core.

**الدعامة الأساسية:** pin مؤقت إلى رأس PR ocr-core#58 (`3996e47`) لتشغيل مجموعة الماراثون **كاملة** ضد محرك المرشح. قبل خروج الـ PR من المسودة: يُستبدل الـ pin بوسم `v0.7.0` **بعد** دمج #58 ووسمه بموافقة المالك.

## الأدلة (تشغيل محلي كامل — venv مع تثبيت ocr-core editable)
| التشغيل | ocr-core | اختبارات الماراثون | النتيجة |
|---|---|---|---|
| M0 baseline | v0.6.0 (79b07be) | القديمة | 146 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed |
| M2 | مرشح 3996e47 | القديمة | **3 failed**, 143 passed, 1 skipped |
| M4 | مرشح 3996e47 | المحدّثة | **147 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed** |

مجموعة الدلتا **محددة بدقة**: 3 اختبارات فقط في `tests/test_ocr_rules.py` — كود الإنتاج في الماراثون لا يقرأ أي مفتاح من المفاتيح المتغيرة (ocr_pipeline يمرر نتيجة visual كما هي؛ build_training_record مستهلك اختباري فقط).

## التغييرات
1. `test_r16_separates_correct_vs_wrong` — بلا دليل بصري: لا `correct` ولا `wrong`؛ كلاهما `uncertain` (مركز أمان الفشل).
2. `test_x_marker_emits_context_warning` — X الغامضة → `uncertain` (كانت `incorrect`) مع بقاء `x_warning=X_REQUIRES_CONTEXT_CHECK`.
3. **جديد** `test_ambiguous_marker_never_correct_without_evidence` — حراسة بقرار المالك: X/x لا تصيران `correct` من دون أدلة كافية.
4. `test_training_record_keeps_incorrect_separate` — بلا دليل مكتمل لا ترقية (positive=None، المرشح محفوظ، status=uncertain)؛ بدليل كامل قابل للتتبع تتم الترقية للجهة الموسومة فقط.
5. `requirements.txt` — pin مؤقت `@3996e47` موثق بتعليق يلزم الاستبدال بـ `@v0.7.0`.

## ملاحظات تنسيقية
- متوافق مع PR #27 (tripwire فقط — لا يقلب require_visual_evidence ولا يغيّر الـ pin)؛ هذا الـ PR هو من ينفّذ الانتقال فعلياً.
- الكشف الجديد عن v0.6.0: كان `build_training_record` يرقّي عينات بلا إثبات كامل (status=verified دون evidence_confirmed/source_reference) — الإغلاق مقصود.
- القرار التصميمي المسجل: بند الفاصلة العشرية بعد رقم التعداد لم يعد فاصلاً (انقسام ناقص اتجاهه آمن-فشل) — موثق في toolkit `docs/audits/ROUND4-*` و`ROUND5-*`.
- يمكن لأي وكيل/المالك تولي الـ PR واستبداله؛ الغرض منه أن يكون حاملة التغيير الموثق.

## لا يفعل
لا دمج، لا تعديل main، لا لمس لـ production ingestion، لا تغيير في ocr-core.

body:
## Why
Live mismatch (verified by re-reading both files):
- `ocr-core` PR #57 branch sets `require_visual_evidence: true` (`src/ocr_core/config/marathon_ocr_rules.yaml:243`, `ocr_core/charter_v2.yaml:21`) — **unmerged**, head `e4e80e2370de8a8ebf5fc3f85a9dd1d16f49ebda`.

Flipping the boolean alone would be inert: the pinned release must implement the gate. This PR adds **no behaviour change** — it adds the missing contract test plus a generated manifest so the two can only move together.

## Changes
- `docs/ocr_core_charter_compatibility.json` — machine-readable per-release gate support (generated by inspecting ocr-core release sources).
- `docs/OCR_CORE_CHARTER_COMPATIBILITY.md` — the rule and the rollback procedure.
- `tests/test_charter_engine_compat.py` — offline, deterministic tripwire: fails if the charter requires the gate while the pinned release does not implement it.

## Rollback
Revert this single commit; the config value and the ocr-core pin are untouched, so no runtime state changes on rollback.

## Out of scope
Does **not** flip `require_visual_evidence`, does not change the pin, does not touch production ingestion.

title: [SPRINT-2][TED] Fix local subtitle fetching and register bilingual sources
body:
## Summary
- Fix the local ted2srt_py adapter: the previous code resolved a numeric talk ID, requested the obsolete non-.vtt endpoint, and parsed the response as JSON. This conflicts with the existing TED fetcher contract and can make subtitle fetching fail.
- Fetch English and requested-language subtitles directly by TED talk slug from the WebVTT endpoint.
- Preserve cue timing when converting VTT to SRT.
- Validate TED host/slug and language code; never label English as an Arabic translation when the target subtitle is missing.
- Add network-free tests for URL validation, VTT parsing, bilingual fetches, and missing target language.
- Register arXiv:2002.10829 (MuST-Cinema) and rnons/ted2srt as source references with an evidence/licensing gate.

## Important scope and safety
- This PR does not merge to main and does not upload anything to Telegram.
- The supplied arXiv link is a paper about MuST-Cinema, not proof of an English-Arabic data split. The docs explicitly require verifying language coverage and dataset terms before ingesting it as EN-AR training data.
- ted2srt upstream is a Haskell/PureScript web application, not a drop-in Python CLI or a documented API. This PR fixes Marathon's own local adapter rather than claiming to embed/run the upstream project.

## Validation
- Added pytest coverage; CI must run on this exact head SHA before merge.
- No credentials, target channel IDs, or session files were added.

body:
## Harness Engineering — عقد الوكلاء + بوابات التحقق + الذاكرة (v2.0)

> **PR مسودة** — لا يُدمج إلا بقرار المالك. صفر دفع إلى `main`، صفر دمج، صفر حذف.

### ما هذا؟

تبنّي منهجية **Harness Engineering** (مستوحاة من Learn Harness Engineering — MIT)
بحيث تُقرأ قواعد العمل نفسها عند **كل جلسة تطوير** من أي وكيل ذكاء اصطناعي
(Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini...): القواعد الصفرية، بوابة التحقق، النطاق،
دورة حياة الجلسة، والذاكرة طويلة المدى (Mem0 MCP).

### الملفات المضافة

| الملف | الوظيفة |
|-------|---------|
| `AGENTS.md` | العقد الملزم — يُقرأ في بداية كل جلسة (مخصص لهذا المستودع) |
| `feature_list.json` | قائمة المهام وحالاتها ومعايير القبول |
| `progress.md` | سجل تراكمي للجلسات |
| `session-handoff.md` | لقطة تسليم الجلسة (تُستبدل كل جلسة) |
| `init.sh` | بوابة الدخول: كشف تلقائي للمشروع + بيئة + git + بوابة الجودة |
| `scripts/verify.sh` | بوابة ما قبل الالتزام: فحص أسرار + بوابة المشروع |
| `scripts/session-handoff.py` | مولّد التسليم + حفظ اختياري في Mem0 |
| `scripts/test_mem0_memory.py` | اختبار الذاكرة عبر الجلسات |
| `docs/HARNESS.md` | الدليل المفهومي الكامل |

### بوابة هذا المستودع

`python3 -m pytest tests/ -q && ruff check src/ tests/ --select E9,F63,F7,F82` → pytest أخضر + ruff حرج نظيف

### التحقق المنفذ في هذه الجلسة

- `bash -n init.sh` ✅ و`bash -n scripts/verify.sh` ✅
- `python3 -m py_compile scripts/session-handoff.py scripts/test_mem0_memory.py` ✅
- فحص أسرار عبر `verify.sh`: لا أسرار متتبعة ✅
- لم تُشغَّل بوابات الاختبارات الكاملة هنا (بيئة الوكيل) — تعمل عبر `init.sh` وCI.

### بعد الدمج (قرار المالك)

1. شغّل `./init.sh` في بيئة كاملة للتأكد من البوابة الخضراء.
2. (اختياري) فعّل Mem0: `export MEM0_API_KEY=...` ثم `python3 scripts/test_mem0_memory.py`.
3. (اختياري) اربط `.git/hooks/pre-push` بـ `./scripts/verify.sh --quick`.

### القواعد المحترمة في هذا الPR

- فرع جديد `feat/harness-engineering` من `main` — لم يُلمَس main.
- ملفات جديدة فقط — صفر تعديل على ملفات قائمة.
- لا توكن ولا سر في أي ملف (كل شيء عبر `$ENV_VAR` / GIT_ASKPASS).

title: fix: make OCR visual evidence and table preservation enforceable
body:
## Scope
Independent remediation of the initial OCR/document-extraction implementation.

### Fixed
- R16 no longer classifies text as correct merely because OCR word syntax is clean.
- Correct/incorrect classification now requires explicit visual evidence; otherwise status is `uncertain`.
- PDF OCR preserves detected check/cross markers and approximate red/green color evidence from OCR bounding boxes.
- EPUB table extraction preserves rows/columns as Markdown.
- EPUB scanned-image OCR carries visual marker/color evidence into the same evidence model.
- Expanded marker set to include ✓ ✔ ✗ ✘ X.
- Added regression tests for evidence-aware classification and EPUB table preservation.
- CI mypy failures are no longer ignored.

### Safety
- No changes to `main`.
- This PR does not assert that uncertain OCR is correct.
- No automatic merge authorization.
- The original reconstruction caveat for messages 1–5 remains unchanged.

### Verification required
CI must independently confirm syntax, lint, tests, and type-checking before this PR can be considered ready for review.
